n0b4dcd09a0.headline: Prices fall but poverty grows: something is wrong in Italy
n0b4dcd09a0.summary: During a period of deflation, Italy has seen a significant increase in the number of people unable to maintain an acceptable standard of living.
n0b4dcd09a0.why: Rising poverty during deflation signals structural economic issues that could affect consumer demand and fiscal policy.

n1ec922c3b1.headline: Czechs took out mortgages worth 225 billion crowns last year. 2016 was a breakthrough year, says head of Hypoteční banka | Aktuálně.cz
n1ec922c3b1.summary: Mortgage lending in the Czech Republic reached 225 billion crowns in 2016, marking a breakthrough year with interest rates hitting their lowest point.
n1ec922c3b1.why: Mortgage lending trends and interest rates are key indicators of housing market health and consumer credit conditions in the Czech economy.
